name: Kanegasaki Castle
text: Kanegasaki Castle (金ヶ崎城, Kanegasaki-jō) was a Kamakura to Nanboku-cho period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Tsuruga, Fukui Prefecture in the Hokuriku  region of Honshu, Japan. It was also known as Tsuruga Castle. The ruins have been protected by the central government as a National Historic Site since 1934.

depictions.name: Kanegasaki Castle
depictions.text: Kanagasaki Castle Kanegasaki Castle (金ヶ崎城) was a castle located in Fukui Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it stood as a fort situated in northwestern Sotomo Gate in the Wakasa province. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historical Site as of 1934.
